hardNavigationDiagnostics.interpretation: The matched diagnostics pair records the caller decision and provider readiness. With zero settle, account A input and completion calls occur while the store is loading, so both comparison events are skipped; the provider reaches committed accepted after the calculation. With a two-second settle, both accounts reach committed accepted before input/calculation and both event pairs are queued. This supports an event-level readiness race as the current explanation, while leaving product acceptance and any alternate cause open. The extra marks are development-only User Timing diagnostics and do not buffer events, delay calculation, or change navigation.
